title: अष्टाविंशत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 128 · Somaka shares his priest's hell

summary.en: The sacrifice is performed and a hundred sons are born. When the priest dies and suffers in hell for the deed, Somaka insists on sharing his punishment, and both then go to the worlds of the righteous; Lomasha bids the Pandavas stay six nights at this holy place.
summary.kn: ಯಜ್ಞ ನಡೆದು ನೂರು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಪುರೋಹಿತನು ಸತ್ತು ಆ ಕೃತ್ಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ನರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನರಳುವಾಗ ಸೋಮಕನು ಅವನ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಲು ಪಡೆಯಲು ಹಠಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅನಂತರ ಇಬ್ಬರೂ ಪುಣ್ಯಲೋಕ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಈ ಪುಣ್ಯಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಆರು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಇರಿ ಎಂದು ಲೋಮಶರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: यज्ञ होता है और सौ पुत्र जन्मते हैं। जब पुरोहित मरकर उस कर्म के लिए नरक भोगता है, सोमक उसका दण्ड बाँटने का आग्रह करते हैं, और फिर दोनों पुण्यात्माओं के लोक जाते हैं; लोमश पाण्डवों को इस पवित्र स्थान पर छह रातें ठहरने को कहते हैं।
summary.te: యజ్ఞం జరిగి నూరుగురు కుమారులు పుడతారు. పురోహితుడు మరణించి ఆ కృత్యానికి నరకంలో బాధపడుతుండగా సోమకుడు అతని శిక్షను పంచుకుంటానని పట్టుబడతాడు; తర్వాత ఇద్దరూ పుణ్యలోకాలకు వెళ్తారు; ఈ పుణ్యస్థలంలో ఆరు రాత్రులు ఉండమని లోమశుడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: யாகம் நடந்து நூறு மைந்தர்கள் பிறக்கிறார்கள். புரோகிதர் இறந்து அச்செயலுக்காக நரகத்தில் வருந்தும்போது ஸோமகன் அவர் தண்டனையில் பங்கு பெற வலியுறுத்த, பின்னர் இருவரும் நல்லோர் உலகை அடைகிறார்கள்; இப்புனிதத் தலத்தில் ஆறு இரவுகள் தங்குமாறு லோமஶர் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: യാഗം നടത്തുന്നു, നൂറു പുത്രന്മാർ ജനിക്കുന്നു. ഈ കർമ്മത്തിന്റെ പേരിൽ നരകത്തിൽ കഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്ന പുരോഹിതൻ മരിക്കുമ്പോൾ, സോമകൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ ശിക്ഷ പങ്കിടണമെന്ന് വാശിപിടിക്കുന്നു; ഇരുവരും പുണ്യലോകങ്ങളിൽ എത്തുന്നു. ഈ പുണ്യസ്ഥലത്ത് ആറു രാത്രി താമസിക്കാൻ ലോമശൻ പാണ്ഡവരോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.128; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: सोमक उवाच

meaning.en: Somaka said:

verses.text:
ब्रह्मन्यद्यद्यथा कार्यं तत्तत्कुरु तथा तथा ।
पुत्रकामतया सर्वं करिष्यामि वचस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, do whatever must be done, and in whatever way. In my longing for sons I shall carry out all your words.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
ततः स याजयामास सोमकं तेन जन्तुना ।
मातरस्तु बलात्पुत्रमपाकर्षुः कृपान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: Then the priest performed the sacrifice for Somaka with Jantu as the victim. But the mothers, moved by pity, forcibly dragged their son away.

verses.text:
हा हताः स्मेति वाशन्त्यस्तीव्रशोकसमन्विताः ।
तं मातरः प्रत्यकर्षन्गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे करे ।
सव्ये पाणौ गृहीत्वा तु याजकोऽपि स्म कर्षति ॥

meaning.en: Crying "We are ruined!", deeply grieved, the mothers pulled at him, holding him by his right hand, while the priest pulled him by his left hand.

verses.text:
कुररीणामिवार्तानामपाकृष्य तु तं सुतम् ।
विशस्य चैनं विधिना वपामस्य जुहाव सः ॥

meaning.en: Having dragged the boy away from them, who wailed like distressed ospreys, the priest cut him up according to rule and offered his fat in the fire.

verses.text:
वपायां हूयमानायां गन्धमाघ्राय मातरः ।
आर्ता निपेतुः सहसा पृथिव्यां कुरुनन्दन ।
सर्वाश्च गर्भानलभंस्ततस्ताः पार्थिवाङ्गनाः ॥

meaning.en: As the fat was being offered, the mothers smelled its scent and suddenly fell to the ground in distress, delight of the Kurus. Then all those royal women conceived.

verses.text:
ततो दशसु मासेषु सोमकस्य विशां पते ।
जज्ञे पुत्रशतं पूर्णं तासु सर्वासु भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then in ten months, lord of the people, a full hundred sons were born to Somaka from all those women, Bharata.

verses.text:
जन्तुर्ज्येष्ठः समभवज्जनित्र्यामेव भारत ।
स तासामिष्ट एवासीन्न तथान्ये निजाः सुताः ॥

meaning.en: Jantu was the eldest, born again from his own mother, Bharata. He was dearer to them than their other sons.

verses.text:
तच्च लक्षणमस्यासीत्सौवर्णं पार्श्व उत्तरे ।
तस्मिन्पुत्रशते चाग्र्यः स बभूव गुणैर्युतः ॥

meaning.en: He bore that golden mark on his left side, and among those hundred sons he was the foremost in good qualities.

verses.text:
ततः स लोकमगमत्सोमकस्य गुरुः परम् ।
अथ काले व्यतीते तु सोमकोऽप्यगमत्परम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Somaka's priest passed on to the next world. When time had passed, Somaka also went to the beyond.

verses.text:
अथ तं नरके घोरे पच्यमानं ददर्श सः ।
तमपृच्छत्किमर्थं त्वं नरके पच्यसे द्विज ॥

meaning.en: There he saw his priest being cooked in a dreadful hell, and asked him, "Brahmin, why are you being cooked in hell?"

verses.text:
तमब्रवीद्गुरुः सोऽथ पच्यमानोऽग्निना भृशम् ।
त्वं मया याजितो राजंस्तस्येदं कर्मणः फलम् ॥

meaning.en: Burning fiercely in the fire, the priest answered: "King, I performed your sacrifice, and this is the fruit of that deed."

verses.text:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा स राजर्षिर्धर्मराजानमब्रवीत् ।
अहमत्र प्रवेक्ष्यामि मुच्यतां मम याजकः ।
मत्कृते हि महाभागः पच्यते नरकाग्निना ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, the royal sage said to Dharma, king of the dead: "I will enter here myself. Let my priest be freed, for it is for my sake that this great man is cooked in the fires of hell."

verses.text: धर्म उवाच

meaning.en: Dharma said:

verses.text:
नान्यः कर्तुः फलं राजन्नुपभुङ्क्ते कदाचन ।
इमानि तव दृश्यन्ते फलानि ददतां वर ॥

meaning.en: King, no one ever enjoys the fruit of another's deed. Here you see the fruits that belong to you, best of givers.

verses.text: सोमक उवाच

meaning.en: Somaka said:

verses.text:
पुण्यान्न कामये लोकानृतेऽहं ब्रह्मवादिनम् ।
इच्छाम्यहमनेनैव सह वस्तुं सुरालये ॥

meaning.en: I do not want meritorious worlds without this speaker of the Veda. I wish to live in the home of the gods with him alone.

verses.text:
नरके वा धर्मराज कर्मणास्य समो ह्यहम् ।
पुण्यापुण्यफलं देव सममस्त्वावयोरिदम् ॥

meaning.en: Or if he stays in hell, king of dharma, then I stand equal to him in the deed. Lord, let the fruit of merit and demerit be the same for us both.

verses.text: धर्म उवाच

meaning.en: Dharma said:

verses.text:
यद्येवमीप्सितं राजन्भुङ्क्ष्वास्य सहितः फलम् ।
तुल्यकालं सहानेन पश्चात्प्राप्स्यसि सद्गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: If you wish it so, king, enjoy the fruit together with him, for an equal time, and afterwards you will reach a good end.

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
स चकार तथा सर्वं राजा राजीवलोचनः ।
पुनश्च लेभे लोकान्स्वान्कर्मणा निर्जिताञ्शुभान् ।
सह तेनैव विप्रेण गुरुणा स गुरुप्रियः ॥

meaning.en: The lotus-eyed king did just that, all of it. Then he regained the good worlds he had won by his deeds, together with that same priest, his teacher, who was dear to him.

verses.text:
एष तस्याश्रमः पुण्यो य एषोऽग्रे विराजते ।
क्षान्त उष्यात्र षड्रात्रं प्राप्नोति सुगतिं नरः ॥

meaning.en: That is his holy hermitage, which shines ahead of us. A patient man who spends six nights here reaches a good end.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नपि राजेन्द्र वत्स्यामो विगतज्वराः ।
षड्रात्रं नियतात्मानः सज्जीभव कुरूद्वह ॥

meaning.en: We too, king of kings, shall stay here free of anxiety for six nights, with disciplined minds. Make yourself ready, bull of the Kurus.
